correctness.rationale: The last shift forces both endpoint bits to be one; the integer oddness conditions are then exactly the mod-two identity B B*=1+X+⋯+X^(7^k−1). Each pair of reciprocal cyclotomic factors at level j is F(X^(7^j)), G(X^(7^j)): their product is Φ_(7^(j+1)), and every irreducible factor has degree ord_(7^(j+1))(2)=3·7^j by lifting 2³−1=7. The factors are squarefree, so one of each pair must be chosen. The base-seven support product has no coefficient collisions. Each one-digit difference occurs exactly once except zero, which occurs three times. Balanced digits are unique by reduction modulo seven, proving the full integer correlation; sign pairing gives the histogram and removes only probability 7^(−k) from the binomial law, sufficient for the CLT. All supports have the same endpoints, so no nonzero shift can identify two; reflection switches each factor choice, yielding 2^(k−1) classes. For the sixth moment the constant term of the product of dilates of P³ is taken with exact transition weights q_(7c'−c); starting at zero, |d|≤9 implies the only integral carries are −1,0,1. Row-vector symmetry gives the two-state transfer with trace 118 and determinant 873; the seeds, generating numerator and leading spectral coefficient follow. I read the frozen checker and notes without executing them. Independent exhaustive length-four binary enumeration and exact Laurent-coefficient convolution through depth four are replayable with python3 /workspace/branches/independent_bounded_checks.py, giving moments 1, 99, 10809, 1189035, 130869873; the transfer, not the finite sequence, proves all depths.

value.rationale: An oddness condition does not normally determine integer pair multiplicities. An exact common autocorrelation on every shift for this natural infinite family and a precise sixth Fourier-energy recurrence quantify the ambiguity beyond the known count and give concrete test cases for inverse correlation and moment questions. The classification is internal to these lengths and is not claimed as general reconstruction uniqueness or an extremal moment bound.
